topics.title: Your first purchase
topics.body: Use the opening cash to buy your first Phuljhari manually. Buying starts its normal sales; your opening grant is not run earnings.

topics.title: A useful tap
topics.brief: Only the counter earns tap cash.
topics.body: Tap the stall counter to earn cash. Up to three full-value taps count per second. Scrolling or using menus never earns a tap.

topics.title: Choose your quantity
topics.brief: Review x1, x10, x100 or Max.
topics.body: Product levels raise normal sales. Choose x1, x10, x100 or Max, then review the exact count and cost before buying. Tap training has its own level quote.

topics.title: Find the next upgrade
topics.body: Cash buys run upgrades here. Filter by category or product, search by name, or switch Available, Upcoming and Owned views. Details show exact effects and requirements.

topics.title: Review before buying
topics.brief: Buy All buys only its reviewed list.
topics.body: Buy All buys affordable eligible cash upgrades in your selected scope. Review its count and price. It does not buy product levels, Talent cards or spend KK.

topics.title: Skills for this run
topics.brief: Buy the base skill, then activate it.
topics.body: Base skills must be bought again each run. Activate a ready skill; its cooldown starts immediately. Reading menus does not pause sales or skill timers.

topics.title: An earlier shelf can grow
topics.brief: Compare its normal income and share.
topics.body: Earlier products can become useful again through signatures and other cash upgrades. Compare the before/after income and shop share in these details.

topics.title: Know what stays
topics.brief: Fame, cards and shop progress stay.
topics.body: Run earnings fill the Prestige target. Reset rebuilds products and cash upgrades. Fame, Talent, unique purchases and decorations stay. First Prestige grants three free draws.

topics.title: A new run, familiar shop
topics.brief: Buy the first product manually again.
topics.body: Your opening cash is ready for a manual first purchase. Fame and cards improve this rebuild. Product displays and skills return only after you buy their run requirements.

topics.title: Two kinds of upgrades
topics.brief: Cash is for the run; Talent stays.
topics.body: Cash upgrades improve this run. Talent cards unlock after your first Prestige and remain through resets. Fame raises income; free draw credits and KK are separate balances.

topics.title: Your free draws
topics.brief: Use a free credit without spending KK.
topics.body: Choose the free-draw action to use one credit. Each draw saves its random card before the reveal. Skip animation keeps the same result. Unused credits stay.

topics.title: Duplicates improve a card
topics.brief: The same card gains one level.
topics.body: A duplicate adds one level to that card and improves its effect. Rarity stays the same. Compare the exact effect before and after; your card levels survive Prestige.

topics.title: Your second-Prestige gift
topics.brief: 100 Kaju Katli is yours to keep.
topics.body: The second Prestige grants 100 KK once. A KK draw costs 100; free draws use separate credits. You can keep the gift for later. Opening this page never spends it.
